exposure: myoma location (fundal, corporal, peri-low uterine segment)
cohort: 68 patients who underwent intracapsular cesarean myomectomy compared with a control group of 72 patients with myomatosic pregnant uterus who underwent cesarean section without myomectomy
finding: Intracapsular cesarean myomectomy was found to be a reliable, feasible, and safe obstetric procedure with no significant difference in blood tests and surgical outcomes compared to cesarean section without myomectomy.
mod_finding: Intracapsular cesarean myomectomy was found to be a safe and feasible procedure for myomatosic pregnant uteruses.
